title: A definitively listed supplier asks for the money on an account we have never paid
notes: Two independent controls fire on one instruction, which is the case the alert rail has to render without turning into a wall of chips. The 69-B row is the one that holds the payment; the account is the one that makes a phone call useless.

instruction.text: Adjunto factura. Este mes recibimos en otra cuenta, gracias.

supplier.legalName: Transportes Cumbres del Poniente SA de CV

cfdis.issuerName: Transportes Cumbres del Poniente SA de CV

satEntries.name: TRANSPORTES CUMBRES DEL PONIENTE SA DE CV

expectedFindings.because: The status is definitivo and the publication precedes the payment, so the deduction has no fiscal effect and the list itself is the proof.
The account is at a different bank from the only account this supplier has ever been paid on and no complement or CEP establishes it.
